arabic_title: دُعَاؤُهُ إذا دُفِعَ عَنهُ ما يَحذَرُ او عُجّلَ لَهُ مَطلَبُهُ
english_title: 18. When Perils were repelled or Requests quickly granted

phrases.arabic: أَللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَى حُسْنِ قَضَائِكَ،
phrases.english: 1.O God, to You belongs praise for Your excellent accomplishment
2.and for Your trial which You hast turned away from me!

phrases.arabic: فَلاَ تَجْعَـلْ حَظِّي مِنْ رَحْمَتِكَ مَا عَجَّلْتَ لِي مِنْ عَافِيَتِكَ
phrases.english: 3.But make not my share of Your mercy the well-being which You hast quickly granted to me,

phrases.arabic: فَأكُونَ قَدْ شَقِيتُ بِمَا أَحْبَبْتُ وَسَعِدَ غَيْرِي بِمَا كَرِهْتُ،
phrases.english: 4.lest I become wretched through what I have loved and someone else gain felicity through what I have disliked!

phrases.arabic: وَإنْ يَكُنْ مَا ظَلِلْتُ فِيهِ أَوْ بِتُّ فِيهِ مِنْ هَذِهِ الْعَافِيَةِ
phrases.english: 5.If this well-being in which I pass the day or night

phrases.arabic: بَيْنَ يَدَيْ بَلاء لاَ يَنْقَطِعُ، وَوِزْر لاَ يَرْتَفِعُ
phrases.english: 6.should precede a trial that does not cease and a burden that does not pass away,

phrases.arabic: فَقَدِّمْ لِي مَا أَخَّرْتَ وَأَخِّرْ عَنّي مَا قَدَّمْتَ
phrases.english: 7.then set before me what You hadst set behind and set behind me what You hadst set before!
8.For that which ends in annihilation is not great
9.and that which ends in subsistence is not little.
